paras: Anolis hobartsmithi, also known commonly as Hobart Smith's anole, the north Chiapas anole, and el abanquillo de Hobart Smith in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is native to Mexico.
The specific name, hobartsmithi, is in honor of American herpetologist Hobart Muir Smith.
A. hobartsmithi is endemic to the Mexican state of Chiapas.
The preferred natural habitat of A. hobartsmithi is forest, but it has also been found in agricultural areas. The holotype was collected at an altitude of about 2,000 m (6,600 ft).
